name: Modao Battalion
headerMeta: Golden era · Pike/Polearm infantry · anti-cav · 310 leadership · Seasonal (S19: Alexander)
pitch: An anti-cavalry support pikeman that stacks massive flat damage reduction through two defense-stacking abilities and doctrine builds, enabling it to tank anything while respecting that pikeman units don't lead charges. Played correctly it beats cavalry decisively; played wrong (sent in first or alone on a flank) it dies instantly.

doctrines.name: Anti-Cavalry Doctrine V
doctrines.note: −40% dmg taken from cav while bracing, +16% dmg vs cav while bracing

doctrines.name: Hero DMG Doctrine V
doctrines.note: penetration makes a huge difference against high-tier units

veterancy.label: Top line (17 points)
veterancy.body: Damage-focused — flat doctrine reduction already covers the bottom line's job, so points go to top-line damage nodes instead.

veterancy.label: Bottom line
veterancy.body: Durability — skippable once flat-reduction doctrines exceed its entire defensive value.

battleRole.positioning: Support the front line, not the front line itself — you don't go first, others do, so shield moves, you follow. Always watch your back for incoming cavalry. {2} Against infantry: X-move in, engage with skill 2, instantly press skill 3 right after, then skill 2 again, then brace for best burst. {1}
battleRole.tips: When skill 2 comes off cooldown each time, press skill 2 and re-brace — sustains best burst in blob fights. {1} Maintain formation with X to prevent spreading — skill 2 targets nearest enemies and causes spread in open areas, leaving gaps cavalry punishes. {2} Brace 1–2s before cavalry arrives — non-negotiable. {1} Reset Toughness Doctrine's first-8-hits mitigation by swapping the unit at supply and re-taking it. {1} Modao Defense and Modao March each add 100 piercing/slashing defense for 3s per hit, stacking to 15 — two stacks alone exceed the entire bottom vet line's defensive value (32% infantry / 45% cavalry mitigation with doctrines). {2}

controls.notes: Five engagement combos depend on scenario {2}: full engagement (charge → stab → brace), soft engagement for high-damage targets (charge → brace), defense (brace → wait → stab → brace, looping — only stab once brace is nearly off cooldown), full counter-engagement (brace → wait → charge → stab → brace), soft counter-engagement (brace → wait → charge → brace → stab → brace). Core discipline: cycle skill 2 (stab) and skill 3 to build and maintain the 15-stack defense bonus, minimizing time spent without flat reduction. {2}
